sections.title: The questions are the easy part.

items.title: The team of regulars who win every week
items.body: Same table, same names on the board. Newer teams stop coming back.
items.fix: Teams of five built from who’s coming, with people on their own spread across them.

items.title: The person who came on their own
items.body: They hover by the bar while teams form, then leave after round two.
items.fix: Solo players are spread across teams, and see their team and table when they check in.

items.title: Scores on a whiteboard, arguments at the end
items.body: Everyone can see who’s winning by round three, and nobody trusts the maths.
items.fix: Scores entered live, standings hidden until a reveal on every guest’s phone.

steps.title: Fair teams before the first question
steps.body: {{brand.name}} builds teams of five from who’s coming: friends who booked together stay together, and people on their own are spread across teams.

steps.title: A team for everyone at the door
steps.body: Guests check in and see their team and table on their phone.

steps.title: Mix the teams between rounds
steps.body: If you want, people move to new tables between rounds so everyone meets someone new. Guests hear about it only at the change.

steps.title: Scores in, standings hidden
steps.body: You enter each round’s scores. The standings stay hidden until you reveal them, so the last round still matters.

steps.title: The reveal
steps.body: Start a countdown, and the final standings appear on every guest’s phone at once.

sections.title: What quizmasters and venues ask us.

items.question: How are teams balanced?
items.answer: {{brand.name}} builds teams of five from who’s coming: friends who booked together stay together, and people on their own are spread across teams. You can move anyone before round one.

items.question: Can friends play on the same team?
items.answer: Yes. Friends who booked together stay together, and {{brand.name}} spreads the rest of the room around them.

items.question: Do players need to download an app?
items.answer: No. Players book on your page and join live moments, like their team and the reveal, in their phone’s browser.

items.question: How does the reveal work?
items.answer: Start a countdown, and the final standings appear on every guest’s phone at once.

items.question: Can a venue run a free quiz?
items.answer: Yes. Free events stay free on {{brand.name}}, every week. The 5% fee applies only to paid tickets.

items.question: Can I bring my player list from another tool?
items.answer: Yes. Import your list from any tool. Nothing changes for players until the night.
